```{r}
library(catboost)
library(caret)

set.seed(521)

# 1. Use the existing train / test from your script -------------------
# (these come from: idx_train <- createDataPartition(nepal_smote_scaled$damage_grade, ...))
train_cb <- train
test_cb  <- test

# Make sure damage_grade is a factor with consistent levels
train_cb$damage_grade <- factor(train_cb$damage_grade, levels = c("1","2","3"))
test_cb$damage_grade  <- factor(test_cb$damage_grade,
                                levels = levels(train_cb$damage_grade))

# 2. Define predictor columns and numeric vs categorical --------------
# numeric_cols is already defined earlier in your Rmd; we reuse it
pred_cols <- setdiff(names(train_cb), "damage_grade")

num_feats <- intersect(pred_cols, numeric_cols)
cat_feats <- setdiff(pred_cols, num_feats)   # everything else treated as categorical

# 3. Build X and y for CatBoost --------------------------------------
X_train <- train_cb[, pred_cols, drop = FALSE]
X_test  <- test_cb[,  pred_cols, drop = FALSE]

# CatBoost wants targets as 0,1,2
y_train_num <- as.integer(train_cb$damage_grade) - 1
y_test_num  <- as.integer(test_cb$damage_grade)  - 1

# indices (1-based) of categorical features in X_train
cat_feature_idx <- which(colnames(X_train) %in% cat_feats)

# Pools for CatBoost
train_pool <- catboost.load_pool(
  data         = X_train,
  label        = y_train_num,
  cat_features = cat_feature_idx
)

test_pool <- catboost.load_pool(
  data         = X_test,
  label        = y_test_num,
  cat_features = cat_feature_idx
)

# 4. Train CatBoost model --------------------------------------------
cat_params <- list(
  loss_function = "MultiClass",
  eval_metric   = "MultiClass",
  iterations    = 1500,
  learning_rate = 0.08,
  depth         = 9,
  l2_leaf_reg   = 5,
  bagging_temperature = 1,
  rsm          = 0.8,
  random_seed  = 521,
  od_type      = "Iter",
  od_wait      = 40
)

cat_model <- catboost.train(
  learn_pool = train_pool,
  test_pool  = test_pool,
  params     = cat_params
)

# 5. Predictions + confusion matrix ----------------------------------
pred_prob_cat <- catboost.predict(
  model = cat_model,
  pool  = test_pool,
  prediction_type = "Probability"
)

# For multiclass, CatBoost returns an n x 3 matrix of probs
pred_idx0 <- max.col(pred_prob_cat) - 1  # 0,1,2

dg_levels <- levels(train_cb$damage_grade)  # c("1","2","3")
pred_cat  <- factor(dg_levels[pred_idx0 + 1], levels = dg_levels)

cm_cat <- confusionMatrix(pred_cat, test_cb$damage_grade)
cm_cat

cat_metrics <- data.frame(
  Accuracy         = cm_cat$overall["Accuracy"],
  Kappa            = cm_cat$overall["Kappa"],
  BalancedAccuracy = mean(cm_cat$byClass[, "Balanced Accuracy"])
)
cat_metrics
```
